title: Protect the evidence AutoML cannot repair
description: Choose the partition, objective, and test-set policy for a synthetic workload. A fast search cannot make an invalid evaluation boundary trustworthy.

splitPolicies.label: Random rows
splitPolicies.detail: Shuffle observations without preserving entity or time boundaries.

splitPolicies.label: Grouped entities
splitPolicies.detail: Keep every observation for one entity on only one side of a fold.

splitPolicies.label: Chronological
splitPolicies.detail: Train on earlier observations and validate on later observations.

metrics.label: Overall accuracy
metrics.detail: Every correct class label has equal weight.

metrics.label: Positive-class recall
metrics.detail: Prioritize finding positive cases; inspect precision and review capacity separately.

metrics.label: Declared error cost
metrics.detail: Score false positives and false negatives using the product's reviewed cost matrix.

scenarios.label: Customer renewal
scenarios.detail: Several monthly rows belong to the same customer.
scenarios.risk: A model can exploit customer-specific history that will not exist for a genuinely unseen customer.
scenarios.decision: Retention outreach has different reviewed costs for missed churn and unnecessary contact.

scenarios.label: Weekly demand forecast
scenarios.detail: The model must predict a future week using only earlier information.
scenarios.risk: Random folds let the search learn seasonal and operational state from after the validation timestamp.
scenarios.decision: Under-forecast and over-forecast inventory have different reviewed costs.

scenarios.label: Safety escalation triage
scenarios.detail: Positive escalations are rare and missing one is the protected failure.
scenarios.risk: Multiple messages from one case can make random-row validation look easier than unseen-case triage.
scenarios.decision: Release policy prioritizes positive-class recall while separately bounding false alerts and reviewer load.
